representation: World-space cloth vertices and one drum center-of-mass state; orientation xyzw.
initial_velocity: All 12 cloths and the drum start at rest at t=0.

bodies.name: rotor_link
bodies.mass_semantics: Original explicit MJCF inertial overrides the sum of primitive densities. The 35 pieces form one rigid body.

bodies.name: ipc_remote_base_bookkeeping_geom
bodies.collision_exclusion_reason: Original coup_collision_links=('rotor_link',) excludes the distant base only.

rules: Preserve every geometry, all 12 separate cloths, rest transforms, materials and bounded controller.
A full attempt evolves from the frozen rest state at t=0 through t=14, including the physical 2-second ramp.
No reference motion, ready dynamics implementation or source engine is supplied.
Numerical discretization/internal steps may change; remap output to every frozen cloth vertex.
The drum is a finite-inertia driven hinge. Do not prescribe its angle/speed or script cloth motion.
Retain cloth self-contact, inter-cloth contact and contact with the rotating facets, baffles, rear wall and fixed glass.
The fixed distant bookkeeping box is excluded from IPC contacts in the original; no active scene collision pair is disabled.

controller.law: tau=clip(12*(qd_target-qd),-45,45); separate passive hinge damping torque=-0.20*qd. Retain inertia and armature, gravity and two-way contact reactions.
phases: 200-step smoothstep velocity ramp from rest to 1.05 rad/s
constant target velocity 1.05 rad/s, finite torque, cloth-driven loads
controller.prohibition: The target schedule is not the actual angle/velocity. Do not overwrite state or apply forces directly to cloth to create tumbling.

articulation.state_semantics: The rotor has one COM sample with its actual mass 18 kg. All 35 frozen collision pieces transform rigidly with it. No independently moving facets.

material_constitutive_law.authored_model_label: FEM.Cloth.model='stable_neohookean' is a compatibility field ignored by this IPC cloth path. The class docstring saying NeoHookeanShell is stale.
material_constitutive_law.reference_frame: For each rest triangle compute its unit normal n; rotate n to +z by R=I+[n cross ez]_x+[n cross ez]_x^2/(1+n dot ez), then take x/y of the rotated edge vectors as columns of Dm. The source n=-ez branch uses diag(-1,-1,1). Use rest positions, not a per-step material frame.
material_constitutive_law.membrane_energy: sum_triangles (2*t*A0)*psi; t=.001 is one-sided thickness; A0 is rest triangle area
material_constitutive_law.mass_lumping: m_i=sum_incident_triangles rho*(2*t*A0)/3; use the exported lumped masses, not dummy FEM renderer masses
material_constitutive_law.bending_energy: For each interior edge L0 with adjacent rest triangle areas A1,A2: hbar=(A1+A2)/(3*L0), Vbar=(A1+A2)*t, E_bend=kappa*(theta-theta0)^2*(L0/hbar)*Vbar, kappa=.4. No extra 1/2 factor.
material_constitutive_law.bending_convention: Signed dihedral angle on the ordered four-vertex stencil, with its matching rest angle. Source sorts the shared edge endpoints and the two opposite vertices; use the same ordering for current and rest angles.
material_constitutive_law.damping_explanation: FEMOptions.damping is not applied when IPC owns cloth integration. Preserve friction and hinge damping; do not add .015 velocity decay as physical cloth damping.

contact_material_semantics.thickness: Cloth collision thickness is the same one-sided t=.001 on each sheet. Center-surface gap is distinct from clearance after thickness. Distinguish them in diagnostics.
contact_material_semantics.collision_policy: All cloth self and cross contacts are enabled. Only remote base bookkeeping geometry is excluded. Keep the 0.0006 m geometric front seam between rotor and glass. Rigid-ground IPC is disabled as in source; cloth-ground is enabled.
contact_material_semantics.force_reporting: external_force includes gravity, fixed glass/floor contact and hinge/support forces on the exported dynamic system; interaction_force includes BOTH sides of every cloth-cloth/cloth-rotor internal pair. Include hinge torque and contact torque diagnostics separately.

containment.note: Use the actual 30 facets, rear disk and 4 baffles for contact. The radius only summarizes the envelope, not a replacement smooth drum.
